claim: In the rank metric on \(\mathbb F_2^{2\times3}\), every code \(C\) with \(\operatorname{rank}(A-B)\ge2\) for all distinct \(A,B\in C\) has \(|C|\le8\). Exactly \(384\) labeled size-eight codes attain equality, and every one is an affine \(3\)-flat. Exactly \(48\) equality cases contain the zero matrix; these are linear \(3\)-dimensional MRD subspaces, and they form one orbit under \(\operatorname{GL}_2(\mathbb F_2)\times\operatorname{GL}_3(\mathbb F_2)\), with stabilizer order \(21\).
integrity: The size bound is proved analytically; all equality-case counts, affine rigidity, and orbit data are reproduced from the embedded exhaustive verifier. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification only for binary 2 by 3 matrices at minimum rank distance 2.
The orbit statement uses the natural left-right GL2 by GL3 action.
An obscure unindexed prior small-parameter enumeration cannot be excluded bibliographically.
title: Affine rigidity of binary 2 by 3 maximum-rank-distance codes
